text: Owen's dad passed away on Sunday morning, quite peaceful in the end, his mum and both sisters were with him. Funeral is Nov 4th at St Mary's, 11am, wake after at the cricket club. Owen's doing the eulogy and is dreading it. Need to send a card before then and ask if they want food dropping round, his mum's veggie so maybe the lentil lasagne.
mariam vegan now, like properly, no honey either. her sister Rana still eats fish

Magda got made redundant last Friday after eleven years at the bank. She's putting a brave face on it but she's clearly gutted, kept saying she should've seen it coming. Redundancy meeting with HR was 10/2, final day is 10/31. Her husband Florin's being supportive but money's going to be tight with the extension half done. She's thinking about retraining as a teacher, maybe starting September 2027.
Eli and his girlfriend split up. third time this year apparently. he says it's for good this time
Louis allergic to peanuts AND sesame. Severe. Carries an epipen. Remember for the Christmas do.
so um Gareth called, his nan died over the weekend, she was ninety-four, he sounded okay actually, funeral's probably the week after next, I'll go if I can
Ellie only drinks oat flat whites. Hates anything with cinnamon in it.
Bethany's mum is having her hip done on December 2nd. Bethany's driving up the night before and staying the week. Check in with her that weekend.
Oscar - gluten free (coeliac, not a fad, he was quite clear lol). Likes IPA but only the GF ones from Bermondsey.
Alfie's whippet Biscuit went missing yesterday afternoon. They've put posters up. He's beside himself.
Need to pick up the dry cleaning and return the parcel before Thursday
James and Natasha's wedding has been called off. She's moved out and he's staying in the flat for now. Don't mention it at Connor's thing on the 14th.

Dawit's brother Bilal is over from Addis for the whole of March 2027, first time in about six years. Dawit wants us all to go out for Ethiopian food when he's here, which is funny because Bilal can't do spicy at all apparently, their mum used to make him a separate pot. Dawit's wife Amara is planning a big welcome dinner on March 6th too.
Connor's 40th - Nov 22. Wife (Afua) organising a surprise at the rugby club. He loves single malt, specifically Lagavulin. Could chip in for a bottle.
Carlos Barros lost his job at the agency. Whole team went in one go. Says he's fine but he's been applying all week and nothing. Ring him Friday, maybe take him for a pint.
manon pregnant!! due 4/18. off alcohol obviously and weirdly can't stand the smell of coffee now
Julien's partner Pieter has been diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. Julien's a bit overwhelmed with the carb counting. Pieter's taking it in his stride.
Zoe's grandad's funeral was today. I didn't make it. Should message her tonight, just to say thinking of her.
Nasser doesn't drink, never has. Big on mint tea. His wife Divya is the coffee snob of the two.

Malik's mum passed on 9/28. He's flying back to Lahore on Oct 25 for a few weeks to sort the house with his brothers, then back by Nov 15 hopefully. He's holding it together but only just, and his boss is being funny about the time off. Must text him before he goes, and see if he needs a lift to Heathrow.
Florin keto again. Third attempt. Wants a bbq place recommendation for his birthday on June 3rd
Afua told me she and her husband are separating. Kids staying with her. She's struggling a lot with sleep. Meeting her for lunch Weds.
Amara does not eat pork or shellfish. Halal. Lovely chat about her daughter starting nursery in January 2027.

Hiroshi Sato retiring 2 November 2026 after 30 yrs at the firm. Leaving drinks the Friday before at the Crown, 6pm. I'm collecting for a card and gift, so far about £140. He's into Japanese whisky and bonsai, and his wife Natasha let slip he's been eyeing up a proper set of bonsai shears. Get the card signed by Wednesday.
Georgia's dog Pepper was put to sleep on Monday. She had her for fourteen years. Send flowers maybe?
Aarav lactose intolerant but will happily eat cheese and suffer, his words. his girlfriend Ellie bakes him dairy-free brownies
Rana's breakup is still really raw. Ex moved in with someone new within a month. She's asked me not to bring him up. Coffee Saturday, my treat.
Note to self: book the dentist and sort the car insurance renewal, it's due 11/12

Bit of a heavy one. Owen said his marriage is basically over, him and Zoe have been sleeping in separate rooms since August. They're telling the kids after Christmas. Owen's mum doesn't know yet and he's dreading that conversation more than anything. He keeps saying he's fine but he's drinking more, mentioned it twice. I said I'd keep Thursdays free for squash so he's got something to get out the house for. Check how he's doing next week.
Mrs Shah next door asked about the plum chutney recipe. She's diabetic so maybe a low sugar version.
Magda's son Alfie got into Bristol for medicine!! Starts Sept 2027 after a gap year. She's over the moon. Congratulate him when I see him.
gareth's wife bethany hates mushrooms with a passion, also v pescatarian. bear in mind for the dinner on the 30th
Eli's interview with the council is Nov 10. He's nervous as hell, hasn't interviewed in nine years. Text him good luck the night before.
Uncle Nasser's 70th was meant to be on 12/6 but it's been cancelled, he's not well enough. Doing a small family lunch at home instead.
Louis Moreau (Lou) just found out the factory's closing in spring. Redundancy consultation starts in January. His wife Manon's doing extra shifts. Worried about them both.
Divya's on the low FODMAP diet for IBS. Garlic and onion are out. Wine's ok, beer isn't. She's seeing a dietician on 11/3.
Need to ask Carlos how the job centre appointment went yesterday
Ellie's anniversary with Aarav is Feb 14th lol of course it is. Five years. She hinted he's never bought her flowers once.

chat w Pieter re his dad. Dad's in hospice now, weeks rather than months, the nurses said. Pieter's off work indefinitely and barely eating, lives on toast and black coffee at the moment. Don't ask too many questions, just be around. His sister Georgia's flying in from Toronto Oct 28 and staying till whenever. Maybe drop round a lasagne on Sunday.
Bilal can't have nuts, any nuts. His fiancée Mariam does most of the cooking for that reason.
Wedding anniversary dinner with Natasha on 11/19, booked the Thai place. She's off red meat so no point going to the steakhouse.
Dawit: brother-in-law died suddenly last week, heart attack, only 52. Funeral in Leeds Saturday 10/24. Dawit and his wife are driving up Friday. Offer to have their cat while they're away.
Afua's daughter Amara has her ballet exam Dec 5. Afua says she's practising every night and is a bag of nerves. Good luck card?
Oscar's band playing the Lexington on November 27th. He's not that fussed but asked if I'd come. Tickets £8.
Malik's now strictly sober, 6 months on 11/1. Don't offer him drinks, sparkling water with lime is his thing.
Florin's girlfriend dumped him by text on his birthday. Brutal. He's coming round Friday for pizza (he's off keto 'for the foreseeable').
James Johnson starting at the hospital Dec 1st. New role, theatre nurse. He's coeliac so the canteen will be fun.

Talked to Connor about his dad for ages. He went into a care home on 9/15 after the second fall. Connor visits most days after work, sometimes twice. He's knackered and feels guilty about it all, and his brother James has done basically nothing, hasn't visited once. Connor's birthday's on the 22nd and he says he doesn't want to celebrate. I should call him this weekend.
Talked to Connor about his dad. He went into a care home on 9/15. Connor visits most days. He's knackered and feels guilty about it all. I should call him this weekend.
Hiroshi mentioned he's lost a stone since giving up sugar. Feels great.
zoe veggie, divya vegan, owen eats anything. nasser no alcohol. sorted for the 21st

Okay so Julien's grandmother, the one in Lyon, passed away on the 3rd, and he only found out on the 8th because the family didn't tell him till after the funeral, which has caused a massive row with his aunt. He's not flying out now, obviously. He's really hurt. His partner Pieter's been great apparently. Julien asked me not to tell the others at work. Drop him a message tomorrow, and maybe bring him those almond croissants he likes from the bakery on Monday.
Bethany passed her driving test!!! Third attempt. Tuesday morning.
Georgia vegetarian except for bacon, she says that's a loophole. Hates coriander.
Mariam's grandad back in hospital since 10/16, pneumonia. She's going up to Birmingham at the weekend with her brother Eli. Text her Sunday to see how he is.
Gareth's leaving do 12/18. Redundancy package came through, decent. Says he's relieved more than anything. Wants to do the coast-to-coast walk in April 2027.

Hmm. Divya says Nasser's not sleeping since his redundancy meeting on the 12th. He won't talk about it with her. She asked if I'd take him out. Lunch next week, somewhere with good chai, and don't make it about work.
Groceries: oat milk, GF bread for Oscar, the good olive oil. Party Saturday.

Manon and Louis are hosting Christmas this year, Dec 25 and Boxing Day. Manon's stressed already; Louis's mum is coming and she's very particular about food, no garlic, no spice, gravy must be homemade. Offer to bring the pudding.

Bilal Reyes, new guy on the team, goes by Bil. Really nice. Loves Ethiopian coffee ceremonies, does one at home every Sunday with his wife and in-laws. Doesn't drink alcohol, doesn't eat pork. Wife expecting their second in May, their first, a little girl, turns three on January 9th. Ask him to the team lunch on the 30th.
